name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas at €84/MWh on 19 Nov, above the €70 Alert line; a Troll field outage and low storage lift prices
state: Dutch TTF gas closed at €84.45/MWh on 19 Nov, 7.2% lower on the week but 24% higher over three months and above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Prices rose more than 4% on 19 Nov as an outage at Norway's Troll field was expected to cut output by about 50 mcm a day, and EU storage was 69.8% full on 19 Nov against 81.2% a year earlier (Trading Economics). Attacks near Hormuz keep Qatari LNG flows at risk.
for_you: Wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills and business costs with a lag of months. Energy-intensive industries and households on variable tariffs are most exposed; Ofgem publishes the price cap for Great Britain.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF Natural Gas (TTF=F)
Trading Economics — EU natural gas TTF

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
